message.content: {"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo describes the December 12, 2022 amendment as an \"'Early Opt-in Election'\" and evidence of \"proactive management,\" but states it is in response to LIBOR ceasing publication \"after December 31, 2021.\" An action taken nearly a full year after the event it addresses cannot logically be described as either \"early\" or \"proactive.\""]}
